what: A pinned Get Started button in the screen corner moves down 10px and vanishes in .5s (curve Webflow outCirc) while the designated section (the closing section that already has the same apply button) is on screen, then rises back the same distance and turns on when that section leaves the screen. If that section is off-screen on first open, the button appears rising from 10px below, so two identical buttons never overlap. The ‹pop› type waits hidden for .5s when appearing and then turns on all at once (original Webflow order).

options.while: Section to watch (css) — hides while this section overlaps the screen. If absent, it just appears once on open
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name (default circ.out = Webflow outCirc) or a value like ‹0.075,0.82,0.165,1›
options.look: ‹pop› — on appear it waits hidden for dur, then switches on all at once (the original site-builder group raises opacity while display:none, then turns display on). On disappear it sinks as is while fading
options.first: “hidden” — starts hidden, and only appears after the section has entered and left the screen once (the no-code tool’s “left the viewport” event only fires if it has entered before — in the original there is no button on the first screen or while scrolling down). Default: when opened, if the section is off screen it appears right away

note: The element is placed with position: fixed by whoever uses it. While hidden it is display: none, so it does not intercept clicks

from.where: shared.js .ky-float (coral Get started button at bottom right — hidden while the closing three-step start section and the News section are visible)
